annotations.title: Weather Settlement Tracker — what each venue settles at if nothing changes

description: Use for "what will the Kalshi NYC high settle at", "has LAX already hit 75" and "which Polymarket temperature bucket is winning". Per station: the running max under each venue's settlement rule (Kalshi and Polymarket US on the NWS Climate Report; Polymarket.com on routine METARs), the observation that set it, the next report countdown, the strikes already decided and the official high once it lands. Pass station ("la", "KLAX"). Settlement data only, no picks.

station.description: Station or city ("la", "KLAX", "nyc", "KXHIGHCHI", "LGA"). Omit for every tracked station.

name: weather_settlement

rules.description: The three settlement rules (Kalshi, Polymarket US, Polymarket.com) in one sentence each.
